Metadata.title: milhaus — Find your home before you land
Metadata.description: A rental-listing marketplace for Americans relocating to Germany, combining on-base housing office listings with self-listed homes from families rotating out.

SiteFooter.tagline: A resource for the American community living in Germany. Not affiliated with the U.S. Department of Defense.

HomePage.subhead: Housing-office listings and homes from families rotating out — verified, in plain English, and taken down the day they're gone.
HomePage.trust1Body: Direct feed from the on-base housing office, not scraped or guessed.
HomePage.trust2Body: Self-listed homes are checked before they go live — no ghost posts.
HomePage.trust3Body: No calling about a place that's been gone for three weeks.
HomePage.howHeading: Moving out? List it in five minutes.
HomePage.how1Body: A few photos, the price, and the date you're out. No agency, no paperwork.
HomePage.how2Body: A quick review, usually same day, so every listing on the site can be trusted.
HomePage.how3Body: One tap and it's off the site — no one calls about a place that's already gone.
HomePage.ctaBody: Start looking before you've even packed a box.

ForLandlords.heading: Put your property in front of Americans moving to Germany.
ForLandlords.subhead: Whether it's one home you're renting out or a portfolio of units near base, there's a path for you below.
ForLandlords.onePropertyBody: List it yourself in a few minutes — photos, price, and the date it's available. We review it, usually the same day, and it goes live.
ForLandlords.multiUnitBody: Managing several properties near base? We'll set your listings up directly rather than have you post them one at a time.
ForLandlords.trust1Body: Nothing goes live until it's checked — renters trust the site because ghost posts and stale listings don't survive on it.
ForLandlords.trust2Body: One tap in the dashboard and it's off the site. No one calls about a place that's already gone.
ForLandlords.trust3Body: Renters here are specifically relocating to Germany — you're not competing for attention with unrelated listings.
ForLandlords.ctaBody: Takes a few minutes for one home — or reach out for anything bigger.

HowVerification.heading: Nothing goes live unchecked.
HowVerification.subhead: Every listing on milhaus — whether it came from the housing office or a family rotating out — is reviewed before it's visible, and taken down the day it's gone.
HowVerification.step1Body: A PCSing family lists the home they're leaving, or it comes in through the on-base housing office feed.
HowVerification.step2Body: Every self-listed submission is reviewed by hand before it's visible to anyone — usually the same day. Nothing goes live automatically.
HowVerification.step3Body: One tap takes a listing off the site the moment it's rented. No calling about a place that's been gone for three weeks.
HowVerification.stampHeading: The stamp means it came from the housing office
HowVerification.stampBody: Listings with this mark are a direct feed from the on-base housing office, not scraped or self-submitted. A listing without it is a self-listed home from an outgoing family — still reviewed, just sourced differently. Both go through the same check before they're visible; the stamp only tells you where a listing came from.
HowVerification.ctaBody: Every listing you'll see has already been through this.
